calls.title: Shaun Blair and Chris Sanders
calls.summary: The team met to discuss the integration of the GrowthBook SDK into Capture's applications and data pipelines, confirming that the SDK successfully captures exposure events for product analytics. They outlined the essential metadata needed for effective data ingestion, including user IDs and experiment IDs, and emphasized the need for clear communication with internal data teams. Discussion included the minimum engineering efforts required for implementation and how existing data pipelines from operational databases into Snowflake support GrowthBook’s needs. The data science team's role in defining metrics and setting up experiments was highlighted, with a timeline indicating readiness for experimentation in 2-3 weeks. Advanced features such as audit logs and automation via APIs were also addressed, along with follow-up training sessions for better adoption across the teams.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, SDK integration, feature flags, experiment data pipeline, Snowflake, data science metrics
